If a [[ring of the gods (i)]], [[Prayer cape]] or [[Max cape]] is equipped, or alternatively if a Prayer cape, Max cape, or [[holy wrench]] is in the player's inventory, the amount of restored Prayer points is calculated with: <math>\lfloor PrayerLevel \times \frac{27}{100} \rfloor + 7</math>
